bluf: Smarketer is a Berlin and Kassel Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising specialist for DACH mid market ecommerce, calling itself the market leader in Google Ads and billing on performance with a guaranteed uplift. It sells CSS shopping, analytics and CTV around that core; its one dated move is a 2026-09 ChatGPT Ads page, the format bookable in Germany since 1 Sept 2026. The Horus read puts it in the Tailwind band at percentile 95. 44 clients are named, 21 observed and 23 names only. A rival should know it has no audited AI visibility product, a blocked Transparency Center record, and 0 scores on SEO, paid social and creator work.
doing:
Smarketer positions as a Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising specialist for DACH, billing itself the market leader, with performance based fees and CSS shopping services: a paid search house paid by results. The headline claim, market leader in Google Ads with a guaranteed performance uplift, is a pricing claim as much as a scale claim. The record lists Berlin and Kassel offices and Google Partner, Google CSS Partner and Microsoft Advertising Alliance badges.

The sold mix leads with Paid Search, scored 3 on an H1 claiming Google Ads market leadership and 40+ case studies, mostly Google Ads, Shopping and Microsoft Ads wins. Three core lines score 2: AI Search / GEO (a ChatGPT Ads page with a GEO and intent mapping pillar, AI Overview ads guides, llms.txt), Data & Measurement (GA audit, GTM, Consent Mode, server side tracking; tracking, consent and offline conversion cases) and Programmatic & CTV (Display, YouTube, CTV and Netflix Ads; mySWOOOP YouTube and Sportstech MSAN cases). Proprietary lines: WaveMetrics AI (a nav label, function not shown), Google Shopping CSS MAX, Whitelabel CSS, Rent a Smarketer and the Ads Academy; services add SEA in housing and Internationalisierung. SEO, paid social, creator, email, retail media, content and web build score 0: breadth 8.

Its AI posture is ad platform readiness rather than visibility: ChatGPT Ads with GEO intent mapping, AI Max and AI Overview ads and an AI Video Unit; the Horus read marks P1 partial because no audited AI visibility product shows.

The one dated move is the 2026-09 ChatGPT Ads launch, bookable in Germany since 1 Sept 2026; no news, no open jobs. Pricing is the loudest signal: performance based billing (leistungsbasierte Abrechnung), a free SEA analysis as entry offer and campaigns for every budget, so P5 reads making. Conspicuously absent: a readable Transparency Center record (the lookup was blocked), a founding year, headcount or owner, and a case study for the ChatGPT Ads line.
clients:
The record reads the client type as mid market and the home market as DACH from Berlin and Kassel; verticals are ecommerce, fashion, home and furniture, sports, pet supplies and food and beverage. The case library is 40+ DACH brands including Walbusch, WENKO, KARE, TeeGschwendner and Mailjet, with a ten year ELTEN case and an Irish Pure story leading the references.

44 clients are named, 21 observed and 23 names only, paid performance dominates the mix at 0.444. Observed paid performance: ExpressZuschnitt (Firstlaser GmbH), whose 2026-09-23 excerpt claims 430 % revenue growth and 398 % more ads transactions; Gep24 (2026-04-27, revenue up 139% from a Google Ads realignment); DeinSportsfreund.de (2026-02-25, +119 % sales with Performance Max); Feelgood Shop (remarketing in Microsoft Ads); KaufDeinDruck, Lizenzstar, Baunzaunwelt.de, Eker Daunen, WENKO and Onlinezoo; and Paradies (bettenraum GmbH), also coded organic and PR for dynamic search ads on its blog. Leads and B2B: ZAPF Garagen (2026-04-27, Performance Max), FAIN, Jonny Fresh and Apfelkiste. Commerce: Marcel Paa (2025-12-29, baking supplies), Kochblume and KARE; SenerTec for a market launch with search, display and YouTube. Names only include Irish Pure, Wunderbad.com, WALSER, Astropet (its 2026-08-24 title claims a +135% revenue uplift), PLAN-B Net Zero, Gustero, ELTEN, Spinnrad, UTA Edenred, Sportstech, Walbusch and Gutschild; for several of these pages the record's excerpt is consent script text rather than copy. Shared: mySWOOOP with refine-labs.

What the base needs next: the Horus read places Smarketer best for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation) and most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two). A book this weighted to Google Ads very likely (moderate confidence) asks first for ads inside AI answers, which the ChatGPT Ads page sells and no case shows, and likely (low confidence) for the SEO, social and creator lines it scores 0 on.
house: Say and do: the Horus verdict counts 1 of 1 tested lines practised on its own house, but the test set is thin. AI search is corroborated: it publishes llms.txt with 6 AI topic URLs in the sitemap. Paid search, the lead line, is unknown: the Transparency Center lookup was blocked, so the specialist has no own ads test. It sells no paid social, so no social test was run, yet the LinkedIn Ad Library attributes 2+ company ads to it, a floor (51 ads match the name query across all advertisers), promoting four free workshops at the market leader. Publishing cadence: 28 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days, 94 in 365, from 485 sitemap URLs; the 2026-09-29 own site read counted 930 URLs and 42 case studies, with posts dated 2026-09-28 on AI in conversion rate optimisation. The stack on WordPress is GTM alone: no social pixel, no testing tool, no ABM tag, no AI crawlers blocked.
market:
The Horus read puts Smarketer at a tailwind index of 35.5, band Tailwind, percentile 95, 16:15 on the Solar Arc, integrity 100. Best placed for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation, net 0.471, driven by AI Search / GEO and Paid Search) and KJ6 (the agency middle hollowed out, net 0.389, AI Automation / Agents and Data & Measurement outweighing Paid Search). Most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two, net -0.104, Programmatic & CTV) and KJ4 (platforms absorbing the execution layer, net -0.067, Paid Search at -2). Scenario fit: The Walled Oasis, 42/100. Making P4, P5 and P8; partial on P1, P2 and P6; absent on P3 and P7.

The Monsoon read is 45.1, band Breeze, percentile 16: migration and displacement both 45.1. The sold mix supplies 45 of the index, Paid Search (14) and AI Search / GEO (7) the most movable; the work would go 55% to Eastern Europe and 35% to South and Southeast Asia; automation overlaps 31%. Footprint observed: no hub office, no onshore claim; the outcome pricing term scores -5.
openings:
The computed openings are two; the record adds three. The strongest judgment is the audited number: Smarketer sells ChatGPT Ads with GEO intent mapping and publishes llms.txt, yet no AI visibility product, scorecard or citation share shows (P1 partial), so a rival leading with an audited citation share very likely (moderate confidence) wins the AI conversation with its ecommerce accounts. Falsifier: a WaveMetrics AI page or case study showing a visibility metric in the next compile.

Second, breadth: SEO, paid social, creator, email and web build score 0, so any client wanting a channel beyond Google and Microsoft is contestable by a rival that bundles it, likely (moderate confidence) for the fashion and home names. Third, proof: 23 of the 44 clients are names only and several recent case excerpts on record are consent script text, so the 40+ library is thinner than it looks. Fourth, KJ5 exposure through Programmatic & CTV and KJ4 through Paid Search at -2: as the platforms absorb execution, the guaranteed uplift rests on the layer Google is taking over. Pricing is not an opening: performance based billing and a free SEA analysis are on its pages, so a rival must beat the model.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the Google Ads line it leads with; above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind behind its percentile 95.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would test whether its performance based billing keeps its edge.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM decide whether the ChatGPT Ads format bookable in Germany since 1 Sept 2026 becomes a priced line.
The 2026-09 ChatGPT Ads launch: a dated case study from the format would move P8 from a page to a practice, and P1 from partial to making if it carries a visibility metric.
